name: past
description: Your Codex sessions become memory, and every session starts briefed.

interface.longDescription: Your Codex sessions are read into a past.dev project when they are over, and every session and every prompt start with what past.dev recalls about the project: decisions, the reasons behind them, what was already tried. Only the prompts and the replies are sent, never tool output, file contents or diffs.
defaultPrompt: Use $past:status to show what past.dev is connected to and what it has sent
Use $past:search to find what we decided about this, and why
